model.name: CR #86-4: current auto-advances at QA Review + next recalculated (valid-focus rejects QA, rollup parent)
model.reason: Tron workflow rule: agents work ONLY on the current task until it reaches QA Review; then current auto-progresses to next and a new next is CALCULATED. The board is 'frozen' today because there is no auto-advance (grep=0) and the pin sticks on QA-completed tasks.
model.tronDirective: #86 (Tron 2026-08-20): T40.1 decline minted CR 4babebb1 but produced NO ACTION; CR hung off the Task not the Test; 'processing change requests' grep=0 (never built).
model.realtime: META-realtime: the mutation MUST emit ViewBus.notify(viewBusKey({type,uuid})) on the ONE VIEW BUS (v0.8.116 live-bridge) for every affected unit so the GUI re-renders IN-PLACE, no reload — gated by the live-MVC standard (ViewBus callback, not poll/reload).

acceptanceCriteria.text: VALID focus = in-sprint AND not-Done AND NOT-QA-Review (extend the existing valid-focus test to also reject QA-Review). A QA-Review focus is invalid => derivation falls through.

When current reaches QA-Review the focus becomes invalid => the derivation falls through to the first not-past task, evaluated fresh each read — NO written step, NO stored transition. 'Stuck on QA' is impossible by construction.

A parent's status is ROLLUP-DERIVED from its children (all children >=QA-Review => parent >=QA-Review; all Done => Done; any child In-Progress => parent <=In-Progress). Coordination-root 37.4 (children all QA-Review, own stored 'Planned') derives to QA-Review and is auto-rejected as current — no special case — and its lying 'Planned' is fixed by construction.

new next = demotion-intent-if-still-valid ELSE first not-past not-current task by taskNumber ASC; buildOrder is DROPPED from the spec (absent 0/19 S37, 0/16 S40) — no phantom field, no silent degrade; a real build-order need becomes a separate VISIBLE fix.
Because both candidate-currents are already QA-Review, the FIRST run of the derivation must VISIBLY move the pin OFF a QA-Review task to the first not-past task, LIVE, no reload.

Seed a parent whose children are ALL QA-Review while its own checklist says 'Planned' -> derived status QA-Review AND not selectable as current; a suite where it is selectable (or shows 'Planned') = RED.
Any status change that flips focus validity emits ViewBus.notify(CurrentSprint) -> pin re-renders live, no reload.
